claims.claim: 官方确认旧存档可以继续使用
claims.evidence: "What happens to my saves at the 1.0 launch? Nothing. Your old saves will still be where you last left them"

claims.claim: 新区域生成要在未探索地带才能正常完成
claims.evidence: "biome generation will only work properly on areas that have not yet been explored"

claims.claim: 官方仍建议从头开始以获得更完整体验
claims.evidence: "we always recommend that you start the game over from scratch to get the best possible experience"

claims.claim: 1.0 成就从新版开始记录，之前击败过的首领可能需要重新满足条件
claims.evidence: "an achievement connected to killing Eikthyr... will require you to kill Eikthyr again, even if you've already killed him 500 times previously"

claims.claim: 多数作弊命令会为当前角色与世界留下永久成就限制标记
claims.evidence: "using most commands (such as 'spawn') will place a flag on your current character and world save, informing you that it is permanently locked"

claims.claim: 拾取被标记的生成物品则有不同的临时限制规则
claims.evidence: "If a non-cheated player character picks up a cheated item, they will enter a temporary cheat state... can become eligible again if they throw out all cheated items"

claims.claim: 2026-09-11 的 Hotfix 1.0.12（目前仅 Steam 版）新增一个控制台命令，可让用过作弊命令或模组的角色主动重新开启成就
claims.evidence: Steam 公告《Hotfix 1.0.10 & 1.0.12》列出该热更内容，包含面向已标记存档的成就重新开启命令，公告注明该热更目前仅推送到 Steam 版本
claims.correction: 补充：正文「永久成就限制标记」后新增一句说明该命令，来源加入 sourceUrls

claims.claim: 官方模组不保证兼容（间接支撑“先测原版再上模组”的升级顺序）
claims.evidence: "we can't guarantee that mods will be compatible with newer versions of the game"

changes.before: （「永久成就限制标记」句末无后续说明）
changes.after: 新增一句：「2026-09-11 的 Hotfix 1.0.12（目前仅 Steam 版）新增了一个控制台命令，用过作弊命令或模组的角色可以主动重新开启成就；具体命令名以公告为准。」
changes.reason: Steam Hotfix 1.0.12 公告新增该功能，补充进正文避免信息过时
对应新增正文内容的来源

notes: 官方 1.0 FAQ 发布于 2026-07-01（1.0 发布前），核验时确认其内容在 1.0 正式上线（9 月 9 日）后仍然适用。2026-09-17 独立对抗验证追加 Steam Hotfix 1.0.10 & 1.0.12 公告，确认新增了成就重新开启命令，已补入正文。
